description: Source code implementing big number (BIGNUM) conversion functions for the BoringSSL cryptographic library, including functions for converting between binary and internal representations, handling endianness, and utility functions for BIGNUMs.

methods.name: bn_big_endian_to_words
methods.description: Converts big-endian byte array to array of BN_ULONG words, handling partial words and zero-padding.

methods.name: BN_bin2bn
methods.description: Converts big-endian binary data to a BIGNUM object.

methods.name: BN_le2bn
methods.description: Converts little-endian binary data to a BIGNUM object.

methods.name: bn_words_to_big_endian
methods.description: Converts array of BN_ULONG words to big-endian byte array, handling padding.

methods.name: BN_bn2bin
methods.description: Serializes a BIGNUM to big-endian binary form.

methods.name: BN_bn2le_padded
methods.description: Serializes a BIGNUM to little-endian binary form with padding.

methods.name: BN_bn2bin_padded
methods.description: Serializes a BIGNUM to big-endian binary form with padding.

methods.name: BN_get_word
methods.description: Retrieves the least significant word of a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_get_u64
methods.description: Retrieves the BIGNUM value as a 64-bit unsigned integer if possible.
